When deployed in AWS, Migration Assistant uses several AWS services to provide a comprehensive
migration solution:
• AWS CloudFormation - Provides Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates to deploy and conﬁgure
Migration Assistant
• OpenSearch Service - The target service for your migrated search and analytics workloads
• Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka - Provides stream processing capabilities for
durable storage and reuse of HTTP traﬃc
• Amazon Elastic Container Service - Runs the Migration Management Console and Traﬃc
Replayer in secure, scalable containers
• Amazon Elastic File System - Provides scalable persistent storage for request and response data
from both source and target clusters
• Amazon Simple Storage Service - Stores snapshots for historical backﬁll tasks and
Infrastructure as Code content
For detailed architecture information, see Migration Assistant architecture details.

hierarchy.parent: Migrating to OpenSearch Service with Migration Assistant
